scripts.verify: npm run tokens:build && npm run audit:tokens && npm run audit:i18n && npm run audit:schema && npm run typecheck && npm run lint

overridesReason: Both overrides pin a transitive dependency of Next forward past a published advisory, rather than taking the breaking Next 16 upgrade that `npm audit fix --force` proposes. sharp 0.34.x inherits libvips CVE-2026-33327/33328/35590/35591 through image optimisation. postcss <=8.5.22 carries four advisories, including arbitrary .map file disclosure via attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL — which matters here because this project compiles CSS at build time. Revisit both when Next 16 is adopted.
